resources.string: The trip in progress, Start and End, and business kilometres in dollars
MilO\'s widget is switched off. Turn it on in MilO, Settings.
The trip, Start and End, and business kilometres in dollars
Type the dollars a kilometre, such as 0.70: from %1$s to %2$s.
To add it yourself: touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, then Widgets, then MilO.

The dollars are this month\'s and this year\'s Business kilometres at the rate above, the same for every kilometre. The rate stays a rate per kilometre, and the dollars are worked out from kilometres, so they are the same whichever unit is shown. They are for reference only: the report for the accountant shows no dollars. Switched off, the widget cannot be added, and one already on the home screen says so, or is removed by the home screen.
